reponse: Since #447 the front end reads flags from the API (GET /api/flags), so the older FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local is now ignored [2][3]. To enable the new dashboards locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [2][3]. The flag was renamed from new_dash to dashboards_v2 [2]. Note the earlier Slack tip to set FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash and restart vite is outdated [1]. Rollout is at the internal workspaces stage, with beta for Fernhill and Orbitly on Nov 30 and general availability in January [4]. If the tiles come up empty on a new workspace, that is a known blank-grid case tracked in KES-470, which asks for an empty state linking to the SDK setup guide [5].
